row.title: RULE-REFS-1: a claim bound to a file nothing runs is not bound
row.body: Audit 2026-11-25. The public revert claim was bound to site/probes.json (mode revert), which no workflow or deploy script reads; rollback exists on the handoff path only. The claimcode baseline held 119 rows of which 87 were dead or already bound. Four site comments said loopback is rejected on lines that accept it. The seed rule file names 353 of 446 files and commands the seed does not carry. Check: foundation/rulerefs.py resolves every reference the rule files name; a probe must name code that executes the behaviour (a test), never a config file alone.
